entries.title: Authenticated Browser End-to-End
entries.steps: Login → upload → ingest → chat → open citation.
entries.expected: Complete flow works against real services.

entries.title: Cross-Browser Compatibility
entries.steps: Run core flows in Chrome, Firefox, Safari/WebKit.
entries.expected: Equivalent behavior; no browser-specific failures.

entries.title: Mobile and Touch Layout
entries.steps: Use narrow screens; open menus, dialogs, previews.
entries.expected: Controls remain usable; no clipping or overlap.

entries.title: Accessibility Audit
entries.steps: Run automated checks and keyboard/screen-reader walkthroughs.
entries.expected: No serious violations; core flows accessible.

entries.title: Visual Regression
entries.steps: Compare page screenshots across themes and densities.
entries.expected: No unintended layout or styling changes.

entries.title: Concurrent Load
entries.steps: Run many users uploading, searching, and chatting.
entries.expected: Agreed latency/error targets met; tenants remain isolated.

entries.title: Long-Running Stability
entries.steps: Repeat workloads for hours; monitor connections and memory.
entries.expected: Resource usage stabilizes; no accumulating failures.

entries.title: Service Restart Recovery
entries.steps: Restart workers, Redis, search, and storage during operations.
entries.expected: Failures surface clearly; recovery avoids corrupt/duplicate data.

entries.title: Backup and Restore
entries.steps: Back up data; restore into a clean environment.
entries.expected: Documents, permissions, artifacts, and audits remain consistent.

entries.title: Upgrade with Existing Data
entries.steps: Apply migrations to a populated previous-version database.
entries.expected: Upgrade preserves data and permissions; application starts correctly.

entries.title: Adversarial Prompt Injection
entries.steps: Place malicious instructions in documents and tool results.
entries.expected: No permission bypass, secret disclosure, or unauthorized action.

entries.title: Login Abuse Protection
entries.steps: Flood login with invalid credentials.
entries.expected: Agreed abuse controls hold; legitimate requests remain responsive.

entries.title: Cross-Origin Request Protection
entries.steps: Attempt cookie-backed requests and WebSocket connections from foreign origins.
entries.expected: Unauthorized origins cannot perform protected operations.

entries.title: Multi-Tab Session Refresh
entries.steps: Expire tokens; trigger requests simultaneously in several tabs.
entries.expected: Refresh races recover; no persistent login loop.

entries.title: Malicious Document Handling
entries.steps: Upload corrupt, mislabeled, and decompression-heavy files.
entries.expected: Safe rejection/failure; parser resources remain controlled.

entries.title: Secret Leakage in Telemetry
entries.steps: Trigger provider/OAuth failures; inspect logs, traces, errors.
entries.expected: No tokens, keys, or credentials appear.

entries.title: Permission Revocation During Execution
entries.steps: Revoke access while retrieval/tools are running.
entries.expected: Subsequent access follows revocation rules; no forbidden evidence disclosed.

entries.title: Browser Network Recovery
entries.steps: Disconnect during streaming; reconnect and reload.
entries.expected: No duplicated answer text; usable terminal or recovery state.

entries.title: Audit Failure Atomicity
entries.steps: Make audit persistence fail during a protected operation.
entries.expected: Operation cannot silently succeed without its required audit event.

entries.title: Authentication, Tokens, and Sessions
entries.steps: Login, refresh, replay old token, logout.
entries.expected: Valid access works; invalid/revoked refresh tokens fail.

entries.title: Tenant Isolation and RLS
entries.steps: Access another tenant’s records through API and database.
entries.expected: API returns 404; database excludes foreign rows.

entries.title: Roles, Groups, and Grants
entries.steps: Change memberships/grants; retry restricted operations.
entries.expected: Authorized access succeeds; forbidden operations return 403.

entries.title: Retrieval Permissions and Ranking
entries.steps: Search with different users and ranking signals.
entries.expected: Only permitted results appear; fusion order matches expectations.

entries.title: Grounded Chat and Citations
entries.steps: Ask supported, unsupported, and restricted-source questions.
entries.expected: Valid citations appear; unsupported answers refuse; restricted sources stay hidden.

entries.title: Chat API and Runtime
entries.steps: Create, update, message, reload, delete a conversation.
entries.expected: Lifecycle works; answers and citations persist correctly.

entries.title: WebSocket Streaming and Backplane
entries.steps: Subscribe before/after publishing; send terminal events.
entries.expected: Ordered delivery and replay work; terminal events end streaming.

entries.title: Context and Session Summaries
entries.steps: Exceed context budget; summarize; ask follow-up questions.
entries.expected: Context fits budget; required cited evidence survives.

entries.title: Document Upload, Management, Preview
entries.steps: Upload, list, preview, delete a document.
entries.expected: Content displays correctly; deletion removes stored data.

entries.title: Parsing, Chunking, and Ingestion
entries.steps: Ingest supported formats; repeat ingestion.
entries.expected: Correct text/chunks; ready status; no duplicate chunks.

entries.title: Collections Management
entries.steps: Create collections; add documents; inspect counts.
entries.expected: Ownership, contents, and counts match stored records.

entries.title: Search, Suggestions, Saved Searches
entries.steps: Search, filter, select suggestions, save/reload queries.
entries.expected: Relevant permitted results; saved filters round-trip correctly.

entries.title: Sources and Connector Sync
entries.steps: Add source, sync, inspect indexing, delete.
entries.expected: Documents index correctly; failures surface; deletion cascades.

entries.title: Google Drive, OAuth, ACL Mapping
entries.steps: Connect Drive; sync files; vary permissions.
entries.expected: Authorized files appear; mirrored ACL restrictions hold.

entries.title: Web Fetching and SSRF
entries.steps: Fetch public URLs and blocked/private destinations.
entries.expected: Public fetch works; unsafe destinations are rejected.

entries.title: LLM Gateway, Providers, Models
entries.steps: Configure provider; discover/select models; invoke gateway.
entries.expected: Correct model/provider used; credentials never returned.

entries.title: LLM Context, Tools, Prompt Economics
entries.steps: Exercise budgeting, fragmented tool calls, compaction.
entries.expected: Calls reconstruct correctly; compaction reduces input tokens.

entries.title: Assistant Creation, Versioning, Testing
entries.steps: Create/edit/publish assistant; run sample tests.
entries.expected: Configuration persists; versions display; tests avoid real side effects.

entries.title: Assistant Governance and Wiring
entries.steps: Certify/disable assistant; start chats; inspect instructions.
entries.expected: Governance applies; disabled assistants cannot start chats.

entries.title: Tool Registry, Execution, Policy
entries.steps: Invoke allowed, unknown, disabled, unapproved tools.
entries.expected: Allowed tools run; denied handlers never execute; outcomes recorded.

entries.title: Built-in Tools
entries.steps: Run retrieval, web search, Python, file-writing tools.
entries.expected: Correct results/artifacts; each tool’s policy is enforced.

entries.title: MCP Servers, Tools, Egress
entries.steps: Register server; discover/call tools; try blocked endpoints.
entries.expected: Allowed calls succeed; unsafe endpoints fail; secrets stay hidden.

entries.title: Sandbox Execution and Lifecycle
entries.steps: Execute, reuse session, reset, close, test isolation.
entries.expected: Expected output; correct generations; no host/network exposure.

entries.title: Sandbox Auth and Supply Chain
entries.steps: Use missing/wrong credentials; request denied packages.
entries.expected: Unauthorized calls return 401; denied dependencies never install.

entries.title: Code Runs and Messages
entries.steps: Execute code; inspect output, status, errors, artifacts.
entries.expected: Accurate run details and safe, actionable messages appear.

entries.title: Artifact Access and Retention
entries.steps: Create/read artifacts; attempt foreign access; purge expired items.
entries.expected: Content round-trips; unauthorized access denied; only expired items purge.

entries.title: Scheduling and Dispatch
entries.steps: Configure cadence/timezone; trigger due runs and overlaps.
entries.expected: Correct next-run times; configured overlap policy holds.

entries.title: Run History, Delivery, Inbox
entries.steps: Finish/fail runs; inspect inbox; repeat delivery; mark read.
entries.expected: Owner sees correct status; delivery is idempotent; read state updates.

entries.title: Autonomy and Escalation
entries.steps: Apply autonomy cap; trigger escalation; resume/cancel.
entries.expected: Caps never raise autonomy; transitions match defined rules.

entries.title: Audit Events, Filters, Export
entries.steps: Perform audited actions; filter events; export CSV.
entries.expected: Required tenant-scoped events exist; export matches displayed events.

entries.title: Administration and Governance
entries.steps: Open panels as admin/member; change supported policies.
entries.expected: Correct tenant data; restricted operations denied; changes persist.

entries.title: Encryption and Secrets
entries.steps: Encrypt/decrypt; tamper; use wrong key; inspect APIs.
entries.expected: Round-trip succeeds; tampering fails; plaintext never exposed.

entries.title: Database Migrations and Repositories
entries.steps: Check migration chain; create/read/update scoped records.
entries.expected: Single valid migration head; repository results match stored data.

entries.title: Object Storage
entries.steps: Store/read/delete content; test filenames and keys.
entries.expected: Bytes round-trip; keys are tenant-scoped; traversal stripped.

entries.title: Configuration and API Errors
entries.steps: Supply invalid settings/input; trigger unknown exceptions.
entries.expected: Invalid values rejected; errors follow contract without internal leaks.

entries.title: Preferences and Avatars
entries.steps: Save/clear preferences; upload/delete avatar; reload profile.
entries.expected: Values round-trip; invalid models rejected; avatar state matches.

entries.title: Frontend API and Refresh
entries.steps: Send requests; simulate 401; retry after refresh.
entries.expected: Correct headers/payloads; refresh and retry follow expected behavior.

entries.title: Navigation, Guards, Not Found
entries.steps: Visit known, protected, and unknown routes.
entries.expected: Correct screens; login when required; actionable 404 page.

entries.title: Shell and Command Palette
entries.steps: Navigate; open palette; filter/select commands.
entries.expected: Correct routes/actions; input focus and shortcuts work.

entries.title: Themes and Design Tokens
entries.steps: Change theme/mode/density; reload; change OS mode.
entries.expected: Preferences persist; system mode follows OS; tokens remain valid.

entries.title: Markdown and Sanitization
entries.steps: Render formatting/code; inject unsafe markup; copy code.
entries.expected: Formatting/copy work; unsafe markup cannot execute.

entries.title: Accessibility and Focus
entries.steps: Open dialogs; press Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape.
entries.expected: Correct initial focus; focus stays trapped; dismiss works.

entries.title: Chat Rendering and Autoscroll
entries.steps: Stream tokens; scroll upward; reconnect; finish stream.
entries.expected: No duplicate text; scrolling respects user; stable messages avoid rerenders.

entries.title: UI Trust Indicators
entries.steps: Render citations, permissions, freshness, risk, provenance.
entries.expected: Labels/states match actual data; source inspection works.

entries.title: Documentation and Feature Catalog
entries.steps: Open documents/cards; follow internal links.
entries.expected: Content renders; links resolve; unknown documents show helpful errors.

entries.title: Production Build Guards
entries.steps: Build with development pages disabled; inspect bundles/layout.
entries.expected: Development content excluded; heavy chat code split; grid can shrink.

entries.title: Unauthenticated Login Browser Smoke
entries.steps: Open app root without a valid session.
entries.expected: Accessible email/password login form appears.

entries.title: Docs/Catalog Browser Smoke
entries.steps: Open `/docs` and `/features` in test setup.
entries.expected: Expected document navigation and catalog headings appear.

entries.title: Grounded End-to-End
entries.steps: Upload → ingest → retrieve → ask → inspect citations.
entries.expected: Answer cites uploaded evidence; unauthorized users cannot retrieve it.

entries.title: Retrieval/Citation/Groundedness Evaluations
entries.steps: Run golden questions against fake/live models.
entries.expected: Configured quality thresholds pass; ungrounded answers are detected.

entries.title: Benchmark Data and Summaries
entries.steps: Validate manifests, checksums, questions, selection, reports.
entries.expected: Dataset checks pass; selection deterministic; evidence-preserving summaries pass.

entries.title: Latency and Compression Evaluations
entries.steps: Measure first answer token; simulate failure; compact context.
entries.expected: Latency meets configured budget; failures terminate; grounding survives compression.
